title: Draw tools → shape creation
description: Wire oval, rectangle, line, and pencil tools to create ShapePath objects in the document model. On mousedown+drag on stage, create a preview shape; on mouseup, commit it to the current layer/frame as a Shape in the scene graph. Uses vector engine types (ShapePath, SolidFill, SolidStroke). Selection tool: click to select shape, drag to move, delete key to remove. Depends on vector-engine-mvp, initial-toolbox-mvp, stage-view-mvp.
